Trump renewed deadline to Tuesday. Iranian FM called Jaishankar. India: 'supports ongoing efforts to stop war.'

F-15E shot down over Iran. A-10 down near Hormuz. CMA CGM Kribi (1st French ship) crosses. UAE: 500+ missiles intercepted total.

kitchen.note: Ceasefire = LPG cargoes flowing again. 8 Indian LPG tankers extracted. Sea Bird (Iranian LPG, 44k MT) at Mangalore. PIB: 30+ days stock, ZERO dry-outs throughout war. 51 lakh cylinders delivered Mon (95% online). USA = #1 LPG supplier. Production up 40% to ~50,000 MT/day during crisis. Prices likely to ease as Brent drops from $117 to $95.

Ras Laffan (17% of LNG capacity) still 3-5 years to fully repair. QatarEnergy force majeure may ease but won't lift immediately. Eurasia Group: 'months to repair refineries even with ceasefire.' India 60% gas from ME — long-term costs structurally higher. CNG/piped gas supply takes weeks to normalize.

Govt cut excise ₹10/L (₹13 to ₹3) but OMCs absorbed it. Ceasefire = Brent dropping to ~$95. If holds, no retail hike needed. Mumbai ₹103.54. Elara: above $110 crude → ₹8-14/L hike inevitable; below = stability returns.

Ceasefire restores supply. Restaurants reopening. Bengaluru cafes dropping 'Gas Crisis Charge.' Delhi commercial cap likely to lift. Bakeries resuming normal operations. Recovery faster than residential as commercial markets price more dynamically.
Govt cut excise ₹10 to 0/L; OMCs absorbed. Trucking costs stable. ₹2,500cr/year exposure per ₹1 rise neutralized. Mumbai ₹90.03. Ceasefire removes immediate hike pressure.

Palm +5%, Sunflower +16% (Nomura). Rupee strengthening below 92 = imports cheaper. Ceasefire eases shipping costs from Indonesia/Malaysia. Fertilizer 50% spike will take longer to unwind — Kharif costs still elevated.
400K tons Basmati stuck during war — now releasing. Diesel costs stable. 30% of fertilizers transit Hormuz — reopening = Kharif crop relief. Onion ~₹50/kg holding.

IndiGo fuel surcharge ₹275-₹10,000/ticket from Apr 1. Jet fuel past ₹2L/kL. With Brent dropping to ~$95, ATF costs ease. Surcharge expected to phase out within 3 weeks. Korean Air, Philippines normalizing. China lifting jet fuel export bans.

API costs +30%. Tofigh Daru pharma plant in Iran bombed Apr 3. Indian pharma margins squeezed. Ceasefire restores some Iranian supply chains. Q1 FY27 reports will show full impact; Q2 should see normalization.

military.t: 🟡 F-15E Officer RESCUED (Sun Apr 5) — 36hrs in Mountains

'Seriously wounded but really brave' — Trump. First US aircrew recovery from enemy territory since Bosnia 1995. Removed POW crisis risk that almost derailed talks.

Iran threatened UAE AI center. Trump warned 'a whole civilization will die tonight.'

IAEA chief Grossi: strikes near operating Bushehr plant including one 250 feet away. 'A nuclear facility and surrounding areas should never be struck.' Rosatom evacuated 200 staff 'minutes before the plant was hit.' 1 security guard killed. Only ~100 Russian staff remain. Bushehr now active war zone — but ceasefire halts further risk.

nukes.name: Bushehr ☢️
nukes.info: IAEA: strikes 250ft from operating reactor. Rosatom evacuated 200 staff 'minutes before plant was hit.' 1 security guard killed. ~100 Russian staff remain. First operational reactor hit in any war. Spent fuel on site. Ceasefire halts further risk but perimeter still hot.

nukes.name: Natanz
nukes.info: Struck Mar 21 (2nd time). Underground halls damaged. Iran says no radioactive leakage. IAEA confirmed damage + enriched uranium still on site. Mountainous construction nearby may be intact (ISIS report). Centrifuges destroyed.

nukes.name: Isfahan
nukes.info: UCF (Uranium Conversion Facility) processes UF6 gas — feedstock for centrifuges. Missile complex destroyed in early strikes. Multiple buildings flattened. Recovery years away.

nukes.name: Arak
nukes.info: Heavy-water reactor at Khondab struck Apr 3 (Wikipedia/IDF confirmed). Plutonium pathway facility — key to potential weapons-grade route. IAEA monitoring. Reactor not yet operational at full capacity.

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Built into mountain near Qom. Designed to survive bunker busters. US claimed earlier strikes 'obliterated' enrichment, but DNI Gabbard later said 460kg of 60% enriched uranium still exists. Impossible to verify without inspections — Iran has refused IAEA since 2025.

nukes.name: Yazd (Ardakan)
nukes.info: Yellowcake plant struck Apr 3 (IDF/Wikipedia). Yellowcake is early-stage uranium processing — feeds enrichment pipeline. Damage limits Iran's ability to produce new feedstock for years.

nukes.name: Parchin
nukes.info: Nuclear weapon component testing facility near Tehran. Confirmed damage. Historical site of suspected weaponization research. IAEA had been denied access here for years.

nukes.name: Dimona (Israel)
nukes.info: Iranian missiles hit Arad + Dimona near Israel's Negev nuclear center. 100+ injured. IAEA: no damage to nuclear facility. First time area was targeted this war. Israel does not officially confirm Dimona's role.

cities.info: 1,800km downwind from Iran. 4-7 days transit at 500hPa. Bushehr/Natanz strikes raised baseline risk. NO national iodine prophylaxis program. Air quality already among worst globally.

Closest Indian metro to Iran. Dual exposure vector (wind + sea). Jamnagar refinery uses Arabian Sea water. Industrial concentration amplifies risk.
Rajasthan acts as wind funnel for upper-atmosphere transport. Aramco smoke plumes potentially reach in 5-8 days. Inland but exposed to airborne vectors.
Southern Naval Command. Oil spill risk 15-25 days via Arabian Sea currents from any Hormuz incident. Backwaters ecology vulnerable.
Konkan coast. Fishing economy ₹4,000 cr exposed. Tourism collapsed during war — recovery uncertain even with ceasefire.
Indo-Gangetic plain trap. Inversion layers concentrate atmospheric particles. Indirect but persistent exposure.
IRIS Dena wreck 400km south — debris field in transit. East coast currents provide buffer. Lowest exposure of major metros.

assessment.headline: DAY 40. THE WAR PAUSES. 2-week ceasefire announced. Pakistan brokered. Hormuz reopening. Talks Friday in Islamabad.
assessment.body:
After 39 days of escalating war, the most consequential breakthrough yet: Trump announced a 2-WEEK CEASEFIRE on Truth Social late Tuesday. Iran accepted. Pakistan brokered. The war is paused.

Trump's Truth Social post: 'Subject to the Islamic Republic of Iran agreeing to the COMPLETE, IMMEDIATE, and SAFE OPENING of the Strait of Hormuz, I agree to suspend the bombing and attack of Iran for a period of two weeks. This will be a double sided CEASEFIRE!'

Iran FM Araghchi confirmed: 'For a period of two weeks, safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz will be possible via coordination with Iran's Armed Forces and with due consideration of technical limitations.' Iran's Supreme National Security Council declared victory and said Trump accepted Iran's 10-point plan as 'general framework' for negotiations. A US Defense official: 'the ceasefire is now in effect and the US has suspended all strikes.'

PAKISTAN BROKERED: PM Shehbaz Sharif + Field Marshal Asim Munir convinced Trump in last-minute calls. Trump cited their requests directly. Peace talks open Friday April 10 in Islamabad. VP Vance likely leading US delegation. Vance + Witkoff advised acceptance; Graham, Netanyahu, Saudi, UAE urged rejection. Sharif called it 'a sagacious gesture.'

MARKETS RIPPED HIGHER: US crude $117 to $103 (-8% in minutes). Brent fell to ~$95. S&P 500 futures +1.6%. Nasdaq 100 +1.8%. Dow futures +725 points. Indian markets open to expected massive gap-up.

INDIA — STRATEGIC VINDICATION: 8 of 9 LPG carriers extracted BEFORE the ceasefire. Sea Bird (Iranian LPG) at Mangalore. Jaishankar-Araghchi call earlier in the week confirmed India 'supports ongoing efforts to stop war.' 51 lakh LPG cylinders delivered Mon — supply held throughout. 60 days fuel buffer never breached. Refineries >100%. Pakistan brokered = India is quiet diplomatic backer. Indian basket likely to drop sharply. Sensex closed +800 Mon on ceasefire hope; Wed open expected to gap up massively. Rupee likely to strengthen below 92. 345 Indian fishermen returned. Only Jag Vikram still in Gulf.

BEFORE THE CEASEFIRE — TUESDAY ESCALATION: In the hours BEFORE the deal, the situation looked catastrophic. Trump warned 'a whole civilization will die tonight.' US struck Kharg Island oil export hub. Israel hit Sharif University + Rafi Niya synagogue (destroyed). 18 civilians killed in one Iranian province. Iranian youth formed human chains around power plants. IAEA: strikes 250ft from Bushehr operating reactor. US gas $4.14/gallon. Saudi raised Asia premium to RECORD.

THE CEASEFIRE IS FRAGILE: Only 14 days to negotiate permanent end. Iran demands sanctions lift + reconstruction + permanent end. Trump says US has 'met and exceeded all Military objectives.' Israel + Lebanon included but Netanyahu reluctant. Hezbollah did not sign on. Eurasia Group: months to repair damaged refineries even with ceasefire. Oil supply won't return to pre-war levels until late 2026 (EIA). If ceasefire breaks: Brent $145+, full re-escalation.

WHAT TO WATCH:
1. Indian markets gap-up open at 9:15 AM IST today
2. First commercial ship through Hormuz under ceasefire
3. Friday April 10: Islamabad talks begin
4. Whether Israel/Hezbollah ceasefire holds
5. Iran's 10-point plan vs Trump's 15-point plan reconciliation

After 40 days, the war is paused. India enters this moment in the strongest possible position — strategic foresight, energy buffer, diplomatic neutrality, extracted fleet. The breakthrough vindicates India's careful all-sides approach from Day 1.
